reviews_5s: It’s bigger than what I imagined! Also the magnetic seal is very secure, it fell off of my very high bed and it didn’t bust open or spill out. It grinds very fast and efficiently. I did customize mine too lolExactly what I needed! It works great at grinding herbs. Easy to put together and take apart. Speak exterior. Also comes with a bottom scooper which is extremely helpful.
